plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-06 — authored audio/video Media Library selection and lifecycle
gap: Authored contentVersion=1 audio and video nodes had no Media Library assetId field in their Inspector. Legacy media nodes could select image/audio/video, but those controls did not expose the authored-node fields. The public renderer and server publication validator already supported site-scoped audio/video asset IDs, so this blocked the planned end-to-end media lifecycle for authored audio/video.

behavior: Authored video has a site-scoped Media Library picker restricted to video/webm; authored audio has one restricted to audio/mpeg, audio/ogg, and audio/wav.
The shared picker honors each authored field's MIME allowlist and kind while preserving existing image picker defaults, validation, and save/undo behavior.
Private draft preview, explicit Save, reload-restored selection, separate Publish, and public media delivery are tested against the actual Worker and Chromium with synthetic Miniflare D1/R2 only.
Muted Chromium playback checks prove decoded published WebM and WAV are playable; the test also verifies exact uploaded/published bytes and MIME.
No Page Model schema, D1 schema, R2 key, authorization, Save/Publish boundary, or dependency changes. No third-party source copied; existing project picker and Worker contract reused.
